notes: THE ZERO-FLOOR CASE. Osobni odbitak (797.40) exactly equals dohodak, so porezna osnovica and porez na dohodak are both 0.00. A porezna-osnovica check written as dohodak - osobni odbitak without a floor at zero would mark this valid payslip as failing.
The payslip still prints a 'Prirez GRAD ZAGREB (306)' row at 0% even though prirez was abolished on 2024-01-01. The row exists with a zero value; prirez is not a field in this schema.
The pay table is hierarchical: rows 1.1 and 1.7 are subtotals over the leaf rows beneath them. Only the three leaf rows are recorded. Leaves sum to 128.00 hours and 996.75, matching BRUTO PLAĆA.
Employer is on the left and employee on the right, the opposite of D01.
